steps.content: █/13, 5:24 PM, at the entrance of Banyan Fourth Hospital.
Why are you here too...
A blond man donning an eccentric mask cautiously peeks from behind a decorative tree near the hospital's front gate.
Didn't you tell me you couldn't show your face in Eastside and asked me to step in for you?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: A true man stands with honor and sits with dignity; why be afraid?
How about you remove that mask before talking?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Ah, well...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I'm just worried about you going into the "den of demons" by yourself, you know.
Donald's voice comes from behind that ludicrous mask, prompting you to instinctively press your hand against your forehead.
Where in the world did you get that mask?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: That purple-haired young lady from your Supply Office handed it over.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I requested some disguise gear, and she demanded payment. I asked if there could be a discount...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's all good, it's all good. The main thing is it keeps me incognito, and it works out the same.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Company's arriving... Quick, go handle it.
Meanwhile, at the hospital's front gate, a towering nurse is heading your way.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: You're the Chief of MBCC, aren't you?
The nurse comes to a halt before you, and it is then that you fully sense the intimidating presence of this psychiatric hospital nurse.
He towers over Donald by half a head, his muscles almost ripping out of his nurse outfit.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Okay.
The towering nurse takes a brief look at Donald by your side.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Is this individual part of your entourage?
...That's correct.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: There was no mention of a plus-one in the appointment.
Thinking on his feet, Donald blurts out:

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I'm the bodyguard!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's not too much to have an aide along when our MBCC Chief is out and about, is it?
The nurse gives you both a once-over and appears to be fine with that answer.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Okay, come with me, I'll escort you to Dr. Das.
The nurse, towering and unyielding like a steel colossus, ushers you into the hospital.
You keep a cautious distance between yourselves. Stepping through the main entrance, you lean in and murmur to Donald:
I can't believe he bought it that quickly, and didn't even rib you about your wacky get-up.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Isn't that a testament to how spot-on my disguise is?
...I guess it's just that we've become numb to the bizarre.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Banyan Fourth Hospital, an esteemed psychiatric hospital with a storied past, also deals with patients impacted by Mania with erratic M-values.
As you walk, the nurse occasionally chimes in with snippets of the hospital's lore.
Well, that sounds a lot like what we do at MBCC...

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: But they're worlds apart.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: We're in the healing business, a hospital. You guys run a containment facility for the Sinners. Our roles are fundamentally distinct.
The nurse seems utterly oblivious to the concept of "a joke," glancing back at you as he walks.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Moreover, under normal circumstances, we don't take Sinners.
Why?
You ask instinctively.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Their destructive power when they go berserk is too great, hard to control...

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: The patient activity zone is just ahead.
As the nurse speaks, his stride noticeably quickens, prompting you to pick up your pace to stay in step.
Here, in this section, you can see patients in hospital gowns, huddled in twos and threes, either standing or sitting.
A few just stand there, unmoving; others make odd, indistinct sounds. Some even seem to be having animated conversations with thin air, gesturing enthusiastically.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: The activity zone is a unique feature of our Fourth Hospital. It allows patients to partake in cultural pursuits, almost like they're living a normal life outside...
Ding-a-ling...
The abrupt ring of a bell cuts off the nurse's speech.
Grabbing the personal device fastened to his belt, he hit a key and asks in a deep, echoing tone:

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: What is it?

steps.speaker: Noise
steps.content: The patients in the lab are having a meltdown... we can't hold them back...

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Understood, I'm on my way.
With a swift click ending the call, the nurse pivots back to you.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Apologies, got an urgent matter, stay put here.
Then, before your eyes, this behemoth of a man, well over six feet, takes off in giant strides, barreling out like a truck at full throttle.
After rounding a bend, he disappears, his footsteps lingering in the halls like rumbling thunder.
Did the nurse... really just ditch us here?
What's our next move?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Next move? Hang tight. You've got no clue where the doctor's office is, do you?
Even then, we're in the midst of the mental hospital's patient zone...
Surely, nothing can go wrong, can it?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: With me here, what's there to be scared of?
It's not fear, really, but there's something unsettling about these patients...
Donald moves in closer to you, murmuring softly:

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You're right... They're mostly innocent civilians, oppressed by Nirvana and imprisoned here under the guise of "unstable M-values."
It's only after Donald points it out that you notice the clear scars on them, some even missing parts of their bodies.
Yeah, if we get the chance, we should definitely rescue them too...
But, there's something I've been wondering.
You pivot, your gaze settling on Donald.

options: How come you know this place so well?

choices.text: How come you know this place so well?

steps.content: You even know the doctor, and you're clued up about the patients' situations...
Someone from the West District knowing this much about the Eastside's mental hospital...
You haven't been here before, right?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: What's that? Networking, man, networking, get it?
Donald gives his chest an exaggerated pat.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: A guy as badass as me, I fit in anywhere...
Just as you're about to retort, a voice unexpectedly echoes from behind:

steps.speaker: Patient A
steps.content: Isn't that... Isn't that the great hero?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Cough, cough...

steps.speaker: Patient A
steps.content: Hey, it's me—the Emperor of Paradeisos. You don't know who I am anymore?
Donald stands rooted to the spot.

steps.speaker: Patient A
steps.content: Stammering and not responding to me, have you turned against me? You're guilty of treason against the crown! Off with your head! Execute every last one of them!

steps.speaker: Patient A
steps.content: Guards, come here! Arrest this rebel!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: No, no, no...
Donald, with a sense of resignation, turns around and puts on a strained smile.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: How could I not know you, Your Imperial Majesty?

steps.speaker: Patient A
steps.content: Just as it should be. Assist me well in my grand endeavors, and you'll be handsomely rewarded... Wait, what's going on with you? You look... different.

steps.speaker: Patient A
steps.content: Has it really been that long? When did you grow such a long beard?

steps.speaker: Patient A
steps.content: Hey everyone, check this out! Our hero's back, and he's sporting a beard now!
"The Emperor of Paradeisos" rings out loudly, stirring the patients in the activity area who, sensing the commotion, hurriedly converge.

steps.speaker: Patient B
steps.content: Is that you, the great hero?
The situation has reached a point where Donald can't hide anymore. He takes off his mask and offers a slightly embarrassed smile.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's me. Little Spud, long time no see. Everything good with you lately?

steps.speaker: Patient B
steps.content: Terrible, just terrible. Drenched daily and still no sprouts. Those jerks from the Underground keep chopping me up, I must be delicious... Wait till I sprout, they're in for a toxic surprise!

steps.speaker: Patient C
steps.content: Hurry up and poison them. If those lab coat guys don't bite the dust soon, I'll be the one done in. They're zapping me with lightning like it's a game.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: They're zapping you with lightning?

steps.speaker: Patient C
steps.content: How would I know? Once you were gone, I turned into the human lightning rod. If I don't get zapped, someone else will...

steps.speaker: Patient A
steps.content: It's all on me... I gave the order for the mole to tunnel, and that's how those rebels found us... I've put him in danger...

steps.speaker: Patient B
steps.content: Hey, big hero, when are you planning to get us out? If this keeps up, I'm going to be cut down to nothing.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: We're almost there...
Donald's eyes take on a determined glint.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hang tight, I'll get you guys out soon, cross my heart.

steps.speaker: Patient B
steps.content: But how soon is "soon"? You've been away forever...
Patients buzz around Donald in a noisy throng, firing questions left and right. Out of the blue, the "Paradeisos Emperor" snaps to attention, his head jerking up.

steps.speaker: Patient A
steps.content: Trouble's brewing, we've got company! Troops, heed my call—fall back!
With the "Paradeisos Emperor's" shout, the patients disperse like leaves in the wind.
The nurse's unmistakable heavy tread draws nearer, and Donald quickly slips his mask back on.
Once done, Donald shoots you a somewhat sheepish look.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Like I always say, I thrive wherever I go... Not just hot air, right?
So, you did stay...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hush—here comes the nurse.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Let's focus on the task at hand. I'll fill you in once we're back, but for now, let's head over there.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Over here.
The nurse opens the office door. You and Donald step inside, and then he withdraws, quietly shutting the door.
The doctor, perched at his desk, continues writing without glancing up.
Hi, I'm ${PlayerName}, Chief of MBCC. We had a meeting booked for this afternoon.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Das Arz.
The doctor introduces himself, but his hands keep busy the whole time.
An eerie quiet settles over the office.
You pause briefly, realizing the doctor isn't going to continue speaking, and then you begin:
I'm here to ask if you would consider treating...

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: The patients with Mania from the West District, I know.
Well... what do you...
The doctor briefly lifts his gaze to meet yours.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: No treatment.
I've been told you're a highly skilled psychiatrist...

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: When I say no treatment, it's not that it's beyond my ability.
Don't worry about the costs, MBCC and the Eastside's charities have got it covered...

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: It's not a question of money.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: I mean it when I say no treatment—absolutely none.
Das's icy and rigid manner catches you off-guard for a moment.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: Better to ask your "bodyguard."
Turning, you find Donald scratching his head, taking off his mask, his smile carrying a hint of resignation.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Das, meet my friend, the savior of the whole West District, you...

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: A fugitive, yet you have the audacity to show up here... You're after the patient from the West District, right?
The doctor halts his writing, looks up, and raps his pen sharply on the desk.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: She's locked in the hospital's subterranean quarters—right where they kept you. Under 24-hour surveillance, your chances are nil.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: Also, don't count on any assistance from my end.
As he speaks, the doctor shoots you a brief look.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: So, you're the Chief of MBCC, aren't you? I'm at a loss about why you're in his corner, but you've definitely been duped.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: This "guard" of yours? He's a former patient of mine—a real ticking time bomb. He pulled a fast one and escaped the grip of the hospital. No one knows how he did it.
The doctor gets to his feet, sifts through a file cabinet next to him, and passes over a file to you.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: In case you're doubting, this is his medical history. Have a look, and it'll all make sense.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: By all rights, I ought to be alerting the hospital's security at this very moment, to snag this wanted criminal back into custody for some much-needed therapy.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: But I am simply a doctor. My role is to treat and save lives, not to engage in your political conflicts with Nirvana.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: However, a word of advice: The Fourth Hospital is a legitimate medical facility, supported by Nirvana.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: Think carefully about the consequences if you decide to go against them.
Das shifts his attention away, settling back at his desk and diving back into his work.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: You're probably not here for medical advice, right? If that's the case, we've got nothing to talk about.

steps.speaker: Das
steps.content: Please close the door as you leave.
With a courteous nudge from the nurse, you and Donald are promptly shown the door of the doctor's office.
Looks like this is going to be tougher than we thought...
Once out of the hospital, you and Donald hop into the car heading back to the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Chances are, Das has run into some trouble himself...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: He tried quitting last year, handing in his notice to the Fourth Hospital. But here he is, still stuck there...
He did give us the scoop on Ms. Margaret's location, though, and even snagged your file on his way out.
We didn't come back empty-handed, at least.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Ha, always looking on the bright side, huh?
Got that from you, didn't I?
You take a quick look at the medical file you are holding.
Things have shifted, so we might need to cook up a fresh plan.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Easy does it. Let's break down the info we've got first.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: We'll find a solution, for sure...
